-- Create contacts
INSERT INTO contacts (id, firstName, lastName, jobTitle, linkedinUrl, phone, createdAt, updatedAt)
VALUES 
  ('contact-thomas-hasler', 'Thomas', 'Hasler', 'CEO', 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/thomas-hasler-sika', '+41 58 436 68 00', NOW(), NOW()),
  ('contact-adrian-widmer', 'Adrian', 'Widmer', 'CFO', 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/adrian-widmer-sika', '+41 58 436 68 01', NOW(), NOW()),
  ('contact-maria-schmidt', 'Maria', 'Schmidt', 'Head of Sales', 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/maria-schmidt-sika', '+41 58 436 68 02', NOW(), NOW());

-- Link contacts to Sika company
INSERT INTO contact_company_relations (id, contactId, companyId, email, position, isPrimary, createdAt)
SELECT 
  CONCAT('rel-', UUID()) as id,
  'contact-thomas-hasler' as contactId,
  c.id as companyId,
  'thomas.hasler@sika.com' as email,
  'CEO' as position,
  true as isPrimary,
  NOW() as createdAt
FROM companies c WHERE c.name LIKE '%Sika%' LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT CONCAT('rel-', UUID()), 'contact-adrian-widmer', c.id, 'adrian.widmer@sika.com', 'CFO', true, NOW()
FROM companies c WHERE c.name LIKE '%Sika%' LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT CONCAT('rel-', UUID()), 'contact-maria-schmidt', c.id, 'maria.schmidt@sika.com', 'Head of Sales', true, NOW()
FROM companies c WHERE c.name LIKE '%Sika%' LIMIT 1;
